description: Title/settlement agent's Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance policy
verification_description: Agent name on the E&O policy - if not found, this is not an E&O document

agent_name.description: Name of the title/settlement agent covered by the E&O policy (REQUIRED for verification)

is_attorney.description: True if the covered agent is an attorney (lowers the minimum coverage requirement to $500K, RM Job Aid p.17)
